title: Pork and Shrimp Pancit
description: This pork and shrimp pancit is a standard Filipino pancit with rice noodles, bok choy, onion, garlic, ginger, oyster sauce, and red pepper flakes.

steps.text: Soak rice noodles in warm water in a bowl for 20 minutes; drain.

Heat 3 tablespoons oil in a wok or large heavy skillet over medium-high heat. Sauté noodles for 1 minute; transfer to a serving dish. Keep warm. Add remaining 2 tablespoons oil to wok; sauté shrimp, pork, onion, garlic, and ginger for 1 minute.
Stir in bok choy, chicken broth, and oyster sauce; season with pepper flakes. Cover; cook until bok choy is wilted, about 1 minute. Serve over noodles; garnish with green onion.

video.description: Elevate your noodle game with this delicious Filipino classic. Preparation couldn’t be easier: simply soak rice noodles in warm water for a few minutes, then get your wok or large skillet hot. Sauté the noodles and set aside, then sauté onion, garlic, ginger and shrimp and pork. Add bok choy, oyster sauce, chicken broth and red pepper flakes. Spoon the meat and veggies over the noodles, garnish with green onion, and enjoy every nutritious and flavorful bite!
